subject: Demo follow-up: proposed evaluation sprint & acceptance checklist — Quantix Systems
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Choudhury <aisha.choudhury@quantixsys.com>, Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@quantixsys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Demo follow-up: proposed evaluation sprint & acceptance checklist — Quantix Systems

Hi Aisha / Ravi —

Thanks again for taking the time today — good discussion and appreciate the clarity on your two top priorities (reducing call-center TL;DR time and improving search relevance for legacy documents). Per our demo, I put together a short, pragmatic evaluation sprint you can run with minimal engineering lift. The goal here is to validate performance, integration effort, and operator ergonomics so you can make a confident decision in ~3 weeks.

Proposed evaluation sprint (3-week, lightweight):
- Objective: validate model end-to-end on representative flows (chat summarization, semantic search, rerank).
- Primary success criteria (you can tweak):
  - Latency: 95th percentile < 300ms for chat token generation on staging traffic profile
  - Cost target: < $2 per 1k generated tokens at baseline batching config
  - Quality: > 95% match vs. your annotated test set on the top-1 rerank task; average summary helpfulness >= 4/5 from a 20-sample blind eval
- Scope: three endpoints (chat, embeddings, reranker) using a ~2k-record sample dataset you provide
- Timeline:
  - Week 0 (kickoff): provisioning, SSO + API key, baseline data ingest
  - Week 1: integration + smoke tests, initial baseline metrics
  - Week 2: tuning, batching/quantization experiments, run acceptance test suite
- Owners: Quantix: Aisha (product), Ravi (platform). Redwood: Karthik (sales), Marissa (solutions eng), Vivek (customer success).
- Deliverables: shared evaluation template (attached), per-route dashboard, short exec summary with recommendations.

Technical/ops asks up front:
- Provision a staging environment and whitelist these Redwood IPs (we'll provide list in kickoff)
- Provide a 2k-record sample with expected labels/ground truth for rerank tests
- SSO/SSO config (optional) or a short-lived API key for the trial

Attachments I’m including: quantix_eval_template.xlsx (evaluation checklist & success metric matrix), redwood-trial-terms-2027.pdf (trial terms + standard limited-use agreement). Links: HubSpot deal and onboarding folder above.

Proposed kickoff window: week of Aug 2 (we can start as early as Mon Aug 2). If that works, I’ll schedule a 60-min technical kickoff w/ Marissa and Ravi to run through integration steps and finalize the sample dataset.

Quick ask: please confirm (a) trial start week, (b) who on your side will own test data delivery, and (c) any procurement/PO constraints we should know.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this running.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Aisha — excited to partner on this. Short technical checklist and proposed kickoff agenda below so your platform team can prepare.

Technical prerequisites (minimal):
- Staging API endpoint or VPC access; if VPC, please confirm egress rules and an initial set of IPs to whitelist (I’ll send our list once date confirmed)
- Sample dataset: csv/json with id, text, and label columns for rerank; 2k rows preferred but we can work with 500 to start for speed
- Service account or short-lived API key for Redwood to call the staging environment (we can rotate keys after trial)
- Optional: SSO details if you want single-sign-on for Redwood Console access

Kickoff meeting (proposed): 60 minutes- Intros & roles (5m)- Architecture + access (10m)- Data ingest & expected schema (10m)- Baseline metric run & evaluation template walkthrough (20m)- Next steps & timeline (15m)

Proposed kickoff times (all PT): Wed Aug 3 10:00–11:00, Thu Aug 4 9:00–10:00, or Mon Aug 8 11:00–12:00. Please confirm preferred slot and Ravi / platform owner availability.

I’ll own the integration checklist and provide a staging smoke-test playbook within 48 hours of kickoff.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
